description: Paraphrased primary-source formatting facts; source prose and webpage copies are not redistributed.

facts.locator: Formatting Requirements, paper size and recommended class paragraphs
facts.fact: AIJ recommends A4 or Letter paper, one column, a font of at least 11 pt, and the elsarticle class for submissions.
facts.policy_boundary: 12 pt and the numeric bibliography are implementation choices within the recommended class; this source does not mandate a bibliography style.

facts.fact: Pattern Recognition requires one column, double spacing and page numbers for submissions; research articles span 20 to 35 pages and reviews permit 40.
facts.policy_boundary: The single-column elsarticle preprint mode and setspace doublespacing implement the confirmed layout. 12 pt and numeric references are implementation choices, not additional journal mandates. Page-count limits require an actual manuscript.

facts.fact: Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence makes a single-column manuscript a submission condition.
facts.policy_boundary: The native preprint mode implements the confirmed column rule. 12 pt and numeric references are implementation choices; this source does not prescribe their exact form.

facts.authority: FGCS editorial office announcement distributed on behalf of Editor-in-Chief Michela Taufer
facts.fact: The FGCS Research Software Engineering call specifies elsarticle with 5p and times, two columns, single spacing and an 18-page maximum.
facts.special_issue: Research Software Engineering – Software-Enabled Discovery and Beyond
facts.policy_boundary: This is the documented editorial-call route with a February 2026 submission deadline. It is retained as a dated route, not asserted as the universal current FGCS submission policy. The call does not specify the exact numeric BST.

facts.authority: Elsevier official journal description and EURASIP journal
facts.fact: Signal Processing specifies one column and double spacing for research, review and fast communication manuscripts.
facts.policy_boundary: Single-column double spacing follows the journal source. The detailed 12 pt source-template typography and numeric references are selected implementation settings, not additional journal mandates.
